title: Increase header
description: A plain 64px white bar pinned to the top for the whole page, 95% opaque over a hairline: a wide uppercase wordmark, six small grey nav links that tint to a pale grey pill on hover, then a ghost 'log in' and a dark navy 'get started' button. On phones a two-bar button crosses into an X and opens the links below the bar.
notes: sticky: put it at the top level of the page so it stays for the whole scroll
the content lines up with the frame of the increase blocks below (page width, no inset)
name: increase-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the brand's name: the home link's label for screen readers

props.name: logo
props.description: the wordmark (an svg, img or styled text)

props.name: links
props.description: the nav links, shown in a row from lg and in the phone menu below

props.name: secondary
props.description: the quiet text link at the right end (e.g. sign in)

props.name: primary
props.description: the dark button at the right end (e.g. sign up)

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: labels of the phone menu button, for screen readers
